Implementation Plan

## Plan: rewrite `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` (smoke canary)

Planning ref: `main` at `34f18dc64a52ba6fedafa47ab042a22aa0839074`. The integration branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so the plan goes ahead.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: this only changes a smoke canary data file, so no workflow behaviour changes after merge

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a data file only.

## Data structures affected
`tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` currently has two lines:
```
status: ok
decompose-run: 41445772297
```
Replace the whole file with exactly these three lines, each ending in `\n` (LF), with no extra blank lines and no trailing whitespace:
```
status: ok
run_id: alt-43115910623
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Replace the whole file
- Chosen: overwrite the file with exactly the three lines from the issue, ending with a single final newline.
- Alternatives considered: editing only the second line and appending the third.
- Why: the issue says the file must be "exactly" these lines. Overwriting the whole file is the surest way to leave no stale content behind.

## Security considerations
No trust boundary, endpoint or external input is involved. The change is a static text file with no secrets in it. The only abuse case is extra edits outside scope, which the single-file limit prevents.

## Risks and edge cases
- Several tests mention this canary path. `tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py` only runs its checks when the `E2E_EXPECTED_RUN_ID` and canary-file environment variables are set, so it is skipped in normal CI. The other tests that mention the path are expected to use their own copies, so the new content should not break them.
- The file must end with one final newline and no CRLF line endings.

## Testing considerations
- Check that `cat -A tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` shows exactly three lines, each ending in `$`.
- Check that `git diff --stat` shows only this one file changed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue names one file and its exact content. The change makes exactly that edit and nothing else, so there is no reason to widen or narrow the scope.
